title: Heavenly Eye Fully Opens
next_chapter_hook: The Heavenly Eye's independent consciousness let out a soul-shattering laugh: 'I am the true fate writer. You are merely the vessel that carries me. The name Chen Ji can be erased from this day forward.'

text.content:
Chen Ji felt a spider-silk-like spiritual sense coiling around his soul, the coldness penetrating deep into his Mental Sea.

He didn't move.

He couldn't move.

At this moment, in his Brow Center, the Tianji Record Fragment was vibrating wildly, and the seal he had been deliberately suppressing was crumbling inch by inch. Cang Yutian's spiritual tendrils had already touched his surface consciousness, like a venomous snake flickering its tongue, testing the prey's response.

However, at this very moment, an aura more terrifying than Cang Yutian erupted from Chen Ji's Brow Center.

It was a power he had never consciously awakened—the Heavenly Eye.

The Tianji Record's seal shattered completely. Chen Ji felt as if his Brow Center was being torn open by force, and a pitch-black pupil was slowly opening. There was no white in that pupil—only endless abyss and annihilation.

Chen Ji's consciousness脱离了 his physical body's constraints in an instant.

His soul seemed to step into another realm. No longer was he surrounded by a modest meditation chamber, but by a vast, boundless Void. Star rivers flowed beneath his feet, time and space unfolded like silk ribbons beside him, and he stood at the center of everything, gazing down upon the myriad of living beings.

Three-hour foresight? How laughable. That was merely the lowest-level function of the Heavenly Eye.

Chen Ji saw everything.

The trajectory of Heavenly Secrets was completely exposed before his eyes—those threads of causality, strands of fate, and cycles of reincarnation were incomparably clearer than any vision he had witnessed before. He could even see each person's destiny flickering like flames, and perceive the Heavenly Dao's will surging through the world like a torrent.

He could see the ball of black light within Cang Yutian expanding madly, attempting to devour his consciousness.

dialogue.content:
'Do you see it?'

An ancient and majestic voice echoed from the depths of the Void, shaking Chen Ji's soul, 'This is the complete picture of the Heavenly Dao. This is the truth you have always tried to glimpse.'

text.content:
Chen Ji suppressed the shock in his heart and continued gazing deeper.

He wanted to see the source of fate.

However, as his gaze pierced through layers of Void and touched the deepest Forbidden Grounds, the scene before him left him completely rigid.

It was a face.

A face he knew intimately.

dialogue.content:
'Father?!'

Chen Ji cried out, his voice trembling.

That face belonged to Chen Tianming—his father, whom he had believed dead long ago. Yet at this moment, Chen Tianming was surrounded by golden light, his eyes containing the trajectories of sun, moon, and stars, radiating a suffocating pressure.

'Ji'er.' Chen Tianming's voice was terrifyingly gentle. 'You've finally arrived.'

text.content:
Chen Ji's mind went blank.

The truth he had pursued for years, the mystery of his father's death, the origin of the Tianji Record—all answers rushed forth simultaneously, yet left him even more bewildered.

'Didn't you die?!' Chen Ji's voice trembled uncontrollably. 'What exactly happened back then?!'

dialogue.content:
'Die?' Chen Tianming let out a mournful laugh. 'If I could die, it would be a form of liberation.'

His voice grew heavy: 'What do you think the Tianji Record is? An ancient miraculous encounter? It is a prison. A cage from which neither I, nor you, can escape across countless lifetimes.'

'The will of the Heavenly Dao requires a perfect vessel, and I... was once its candidate.'

text.content:
Chen Tianming's figure began to dissolve, replaced by a massive eye that blotted out the sky.

That giant eye was ten thousand times more terrifying than any omen he had seen before, its pupil seemingly containing the extinction of an entire universe.

'Do you see it?' The voice became cold and mechanical. 'This is the本体 of the Heavenly Dao. It is not a personified existence, but a rule—a rule that devours everything, that destroys everything.'

'And the so-called Tianji Record is merely bait it cast.' Chen Tianming's voice rang out again, but with deep bitterness. 'It needs a vessel, needs an intelligent being to bear its will, and your "prophetic" ability is merely a tool for it to draw nutrients.'

'Every time you use the Tianji Record, you are exchanging with it. You think it is your Heavenly Fate Value being consumed, but in reality, it is your soul.'

Chen Ji felt a chill rising from the depths of his soul.

He recalled the weakness after each use of the Tianji Record, the blurry prophetic visions, the gradual decrease of his Heavenly Fate Value—turns out, from the very beginning, he had been slowly devoured.

'So you chose self-seal?' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. 'Better to be atrash than to become its puppet?'

dialogue.content:
Chen Tianming's figure coalesced once more, this time with deep guilt in his eyes.

'I failed to protect you.' His voice was low. 'When I discovered the truth back then, I wanted to escape, but the Heavenly Dao noticed. It needed a more perfect vessel, so it turned its gaze to... you.'

text.content:
Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly.

So his 'trash' persona, his restraint, all his schemes—were merely methods of raising a silkworm in the Heavenly Dao's eyes?

'It has been waiting all along.' Chen Tianming's voice was heavy. 'Waiting for you to become strong enough, waiting for your soul to become full enough, and then it would...'

Before he could finish, a will a myriad times more terrifying than before suddenly erupted, directly crashing into Chen Ji's Mental Sea!

'Enough.'

A cold voice rang out from within Chen Ji—it wasn't his voice—it was the voice of the Heavenly Eye!

Chen Ji felt in horror an invisible hand seizing control of his body. His limbs lifted without his command, his Mental Sea was being invaded, torn, and devoured by another consciousness!

'Chen Ji, did you think you were the Chess Player?' The Heavenly Eye's voice carried mockery. 'Laughable. You have always been a piece.'

dialogue.content:
'No!' Chen Tianming's figure rushed over desperately, yet was死死 pressed down by that giant eye. 'Release him! He is my son!'

'Son?' The Heavenly Eye let out a contemptuous laugh. 'Merely a chess piece to be used and discarded. Chen Tianming, you were just as naive back then, thinking you could escape my control. And look what happened? You couldn't even protect yourself.'

text.content:
Chen Ji felt his consciousness being stripped away bit by bit.

The Heavenly Eye's will was like a hungry giant beast, devouring his soul. His body floated up involuntarily, the Heavenly Eye at his Brow Center fully opened, emanating destructive light.

'Chen Ji!' The Heavenly Eye's voice became狂热. 'Surrender control! This is your destiny, this is the meaning of your existence!'

Chen Ji felt his consciousness fading away.

That sensation was more terrifying than death—he was losing himself, losing his existence, losing every goal he had fought for.

Su Qingyao's trust, Ye Qing's alliance, Chen Nian's search—everything would turn to nothing.

No!

He could not surrender like this!

Two wills clashed violently in the Mental Sea, each impact causing Chen Ji unbearable agony.

text.content:
Chen Ji made a reckless choice - he stopped resisting and proactively opened his soul to welcome the Heavenly Eye's invasion.

'Come then.' He coldly smiled in his heart, 'You think you're the hunter, but you don't know that I am the true hunter.'

dialogue.content:
The Heavenly Eye was clearly taken aback, seemingly not expecting Chen Ji to come to it willingly.

'Foolish!' It let out a roar, its consciousness surging into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a flood.

However, in that instant, Chen Ji's Tianji Record suddenly erupted with dazzling light, trapping that mass of dark consciousness in a death grip!

text.content:
Chen Ji's consciousness suddenly softened, taking on a posture of surrender.

The Heavenly Eye let out a triumphant laugh: 'Finally came to your senses! If you had known this earlier, why suffer at the beginning—'

Yet its laughter stopped abruptly.

dialogue.content: A cold smirk curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, yet his voice carried a trembling note of despair: 'Senior Heavenly Eye, you've forgotten my greatest talent—playing the pig to swallow the tiger.'

text.content:
The battle in the Mental Sea had reached a white-hot intensity.

Chen Ji felt his consciousness being slowly eroded, the Heavenly Eye's will like a bone-burrowing maggot, constantly corroding the boundaries of his soul. His vision narrowed more and more, his thoughts grew increasingly sluggish, and the terror of imminent dissolution surged over him like a tide.

'Father...' he called in his heart, 'tell me, is there any other way...'

dialogue.content:
'There is one method.' Chen Tianming's voice struggled to transmit, 'The Heavenly Eye can invade you because it is parasitic on your Tianji Record. If you could sever this connection—'

'Sever the connection?' The Heavenly Eye let out a sharp mockery, 'Do you think I'll give him that chance!'

A terrifying force erupted violently, directly shattering Chen Tianming's figure!

text.content:
'FATHER!!' Chen Ji let out a heart-wrenching cry.

However, at this moment, he sensed something.

Deep within the Tianji Record, a faint consciousness flickered—Mo Xiansheng's hidden contingency!

'Young man.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was weak yet clear, 'The Heavenly Eye's independent consciousness has awakened. It is no longer a pure Heavenly Dao will. From now on, it is the third competitor.'

text.content: A fierce glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes - since the Heavenly Eye already has independent consciousness, that means it can be contested! He abruptly opened his divine soul, like a hungry wolf pouncing on a lamb, directly dragging the Heavenly Eye's consciousness into the depths of his Mental Sea! "You -!" The Heavenly Eye let out a terrified scream, "You're mad! This way we'll both die!"

dialogue.content: "Then let's die together!" Chen Ji's voice was cold and resolute, "But before that, I will let you know what it means to die together!" The two consciousnesses collided violently in the Mental Sea, each impact stirring monstrous waves, the entire Void trembling!

text.content: Just as Chen Ji and the Heavenly Eye's consciousness collided intensely, Cang Yutian's divine sense suddenly multiplied tenfold! "Found it!" Cang Yutian let out a wild laugh, "As expected, it's here! Chen Ji, did you think you could escape this seat's divine sense detection? Heaven-sent opportunity, today is your death!" A world-destroying attack pierced through the Void, directly targeting Chen Ji's Mental Sea!

Under simultaneous pressure from within and without, Chen Ji's consciousness could finally hold on no longer. His divine soul began disintegrating under the dual attacks of the Heavenly Eye and Cang Yutian, the tearing pain nearly making him lose consciousness. "No... I cannot end like this..." He gritted his teeth, desperately maintaining the last thread of clarity, "Chen Nian... I haven't found her yet..."

dialogue.content: At this moment, a weak yet resolute voice sounded in his mind. "Brother..." It was Chen Nian! Chen Ji's pupils dilated sharply, the voice crystal clear, carrying familiar warmth: "Brother, I sensed you. You must hold on, I'm coming to find you -" Before the words finished, a pure power suddenly flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea, reconverging his disintegrating divine soul!

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness rapidly recovered under the nourishment of pure power. He felt a familiar aura surrounding him - that was Chen Nian's unique Heavenly Fate Lock Key power - she could actually transmit power across endless Void! "Nian'er..." Chen Ji's eyes grew moist, "Wait for me, brother will definitely come save you..."

After obtaining Chen Nian's power, Chen Ji's divine soul swelled dramatically. He was no longer the prey being passively beaten, but a hunter who had seized the initiative! "Heavenly Eye." His voice was cold and majestic, "I give you a choice. Submit to me, or - dissipate forever." The pitch-black pupil trembled violently, seemingly intimidated by Chen Ji's sudden burst of momentum.

However, at this moment, a disdainful snicker echoed from the depths of the Mental Sea. That laughter belonged neither to the Heavenly Eye, nor to Chen Tianming, nor to Chen Nian - it was the contempt from a higher existence. "Interesting." A presence capable of making stars fall suddenly descended, Chen Ji's consciousness was forcibly locked in place, unable to move. "An ant dares threaten this seat's avatar?"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Heavenly Dao Eye. The true mastermind, finally took action personally! He felt an irresistible force eroding his consciousness boundary, the gap like a firefly against the bright moon, completely not on the same level. "You..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, "You are the true writer of destiny..."

"Writer of destiny?" That voice carried a playful smile, "That title is not bad. But this seat prefers another name - Heavenly Dao." "All living beings are on this seat's chessboard. You think you are scheming, not knowing that every step you take is within this seat's expectations." Chen Ji felt his consciousness being crushed piece by piece, that despair nearly suffocating him.

"But just at this moment, a burst of golden light suddenly erupted!

"Enough!" Chen Tianming's figure coalesced once more, burning with radiant divine light. "Heaven, you have used my father and son for so many years. Today, let me show you—what it means when a fish dies and the net is destroyed!"

Chen Tianming's voice carried absolute resolve. His form was dissipating visibly before the naked eye—that was the price of burning his divine soul!"

dialogue.content:
""Father!" Chen Ji let out a heart-wrenching cry.

"Ji'er, remember." Chen Tianming's voice grew increasingly faint, yet carried unprecedented tenderness. "The true secret of the Tianji Record lies not in Heaven, but in... the human heart... your sister... she is the key..."

Before the words could finish, Chen Tianming's form completely dissipated, transforming into a warm light that merged into Chen Ji's divine soul."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt an enormous surge of information flooding into his Mental Sea.

It was Chen Tianming's lifetime of memories and insights, his accumulated experience from thousands of years of chess games against Heaven, his final legacy to his son.

"Many thanks, old thing." A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips, yet his eyes blazed with towering hatred. "What you owe me, I will collect, one debt at a time."

His consciousness abruptly returned to the real world.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes.

Around him was still that simple meditation room. Cang Yutian's divine sense still coiled nearby, but could advance no further.

Because a completely new power had emerged within him—Chen Tianming's remnant will, forming a three-way standoff with the Heaven's Eye and the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

"Interesting." Chen Ji murmured. "Three competitors. It seems this chess game is more complex than I imagined."

The Heaven's Eye let out a hoarse laugh from the depths of the Mental Sea.

Gone was the previous arrogance, replaced by wariness and... a hint of wanting to cooperate?

"Chen Ji, you are more interesting than I anticipated." The Heaven's Eye's voice turned icy cold. "We have both been used by Heaven, both want to break free from this chess game. Since that is the case—"

"How about we join forces?"

A playful smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips.

"Join forces?" He coldly thought in his heart. "You merely want my body as your new host. But it doesn't matter. I want to see what kind of sparks will fly from cooperating with a wolf in sheep's clothing."

He rose to his feet and pushed open the meditation room's door.

The outside world remained unchanged as the Tianqing Sect, but in his eyes, everything was different.

Because he had now seen the truth.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao—that transcendent consciousness—was the true mastermind. His father Chen Tianming, once a chess piece, now a remnant soul. The Heaven's Eye—former avatar, now the third competitor.

And himself—

"I have always been a chess piece." Chen Ji said softly, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes. "But a chess piece can also devour the chess player."

In the distance, Cang Yutian's figure hovered above the high heavens, gazing down at the entire Tianqing Sect.

He sensed Chen Ji's aura and a playful smile curled at the corner of his lips: "Interesting. To actually endure under my divine sense suppression for so long. No wonder he is a descendant of that person."

"Unfortunately—" His voice turned ice-cold. "No matter how powerful an ant is, it remains an ant."

Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze colliding with Cang Yutian's in mid-air.

He did not evade. Instead, he smiled faintly, that smile carrying indescribable implications.

"Senior Cang Yutian." His voice was clear and bright. "Today's favor, the junior will remember in my heart."

"When we meet again, there will surely be a generous repayment."

As the words fell, Chen Ji turned and walked into the crowd, vanishing in the vast sea of people in an instant.

A slight frown creased Cang Yutian's brow.

That feeling... was it a prey escaping, or a chess player making a move? He actually could not see through thistrash disciple.

"Interesting." He murmured. "It seems this seat needs to re-evaluate this chess piece."

Yet he did not know that in the higher虚空 above him, a pair of cold eyes was watching all of this.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao had finally awakened completely.

Chen Ji walked along the Tianqing Sect's path, his mind racing at lightning speed.

His father's memories told him the Tianji Record contained nine pages, each sealing a portion of the Eye of Heavenly Dao's power. And he currently had only obtained three pages.

"To oppose the Eye of Heavenly Dao, I must gather all the fragments." He murmured. "And the unlocking condition for each page is closely tied to my overall布局."

Just then, a familiar aura appeared behind him.

"Chen Ji." Su Qingyao's voice was cold and carried a hint of confusion. "That刚才的气息... was it you?"

Chen Ji turned around, looking at this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow who had been trying to investigate him, a gentle smile curling at the corner of his lips: "Senior Sister Su, what are you saying? I don't understand a word."

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed even tighter. Those bright eyes flickered with a scrutinizing light.

"Your aura has changed." Su Qingyao's voice was cold. "Become even more... profound. I have never seen someone change so dramatically in such a short time."

She stepped forward, her distance from Chen Ji mere inches: "Who exactly are you?"

Chen Ji gazed into her eyes, a complex emotion flickering in his heart. This woman had already come infinitely close to the truth three times.

"Who am I?" Chen Ji smiled. "I am Chen Ji, a Servant Disciple of the Tianqing Sect, aren't I? Didn't Senior Sister Su say so yourself?"

His smile was warm and harmless, completely different from the ruthless figure who had just confronted the Heaven's Eye.

Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on his face for a long while. Finally, she sighed softly: "Fine. But I will be watching you."

She turned and left, her back view carrying reluctance and confusion.

Chen Ji watched her departing figure, a hint of tenderness flickering in his eyes.

This woman... was rather interesting. In the past, he might have regarded her as a threat. But now—

"Su Qingyao." He murmured. "Perhaps we could become friends."

The words had barely fallen when a transmission talisman drifted into his hand.

It was Ye Qing's message: "Chen Ji, there is unusual movement from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. Come quickly."

Chen Ji crushed the talisman, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips.

"Perfect timing." He murmured. "The Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, the Tianqing Sect, the Xuanwu Sect... and that Holy Sect."

He raised his head, gazing toward the distant horizon where a patch of dark clouds was slowly gathering.

"Chaotic times are coming, various forces are stirring. And I—" his eyes shimmered with brilliance. "will take advantage of the chaos to set up my pieces."

He strode toward the sect's exit.

However, just at this moment, an icy voice rang out in his mind.

It was the Heaven's Eye's voice, yet completely different from before—filled with arrogance and ambition born from awakened independent consciousness.

"Chen Ji, do you think you have won?" The Heaven's Eye's voice carried a playful smile. "No, you and I are merely temporarily cooperating. From this day forward, I am the third competitor."

"I am the true writer of destiny."

Chen Ji's footsteps paused slightly, then a meaningful smile curled at the corner of his lips.

"The true writer of destiny?" He murmured, his voice audible only to himself. "Then so what."

"This chess game is getting bigger and bigger, with more and more chess players. Excellent—"

A sharp gleam flickered in his eyes: "The more chaotic, the better. Only by fishing in troubled waters can a hero reveal his true colors."

He strode forward, his figure vanishing at the sect's end.

And in the虚空 far above, those cold eyes watched it all, their depths shimmering with a playful light.

"Interesting." The Eye of Heavenly Dao murmured. "This chess piece is more valuable than I imagined."
